# Pitch Black

Pitch Black uses pure black backgrounds throughout Obsidian, which the description presents as OLED-friendly and high-contrast. Syntax highlighting follows the VSCode Dark+ palette, and the styling is kept consistent across UI elements and code blocks.

![Pitch Black screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aterrylu/obsidian-pitch-black/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Pitch Black"
    author: "aterrylu"
    repo:   "aterrylu/obsidian-pitch-black"
    slug:   "pitch-black"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/pitch-black"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/aterrylu/obsidian-pitch-black"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aterrylu/obsidian-pitch-black/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Apply a true black UI with pure #000000 backgrounds throughout Obsidian for OLED-friendly, high-contrast text. Use VSCode Dark+-inspired syntax highlighting and consistent styling across all UI elements and code blocks."
}
```
